none: PAS NLM-5EFADC: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361); small module, possibly a Phoenix on mound issue of 348-351, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: [Phoenix standing right] on rocky mound. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter (long axis): 17.4mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: probably 12
